sections.text: Muta'addid aayat mein mukhtalif ashya ki mukhtalif mawaqe par halat ya kaifiyat ko kisi cheez se tashbeeh dene ke liye (كَأَنَّ) ka lafz aata hai jis ka matlab hai (goya ke). Choonke umooman tashbeeh nayab ya door ki cheezon se di jati hai, lehaza iss muhavre mein umooman kam musta'mil aur mushkil alfaaz hain. Darj kiye gaye ma'ani ki madad se darj zail Qur'ani jumlon ka tarjuma kijiye.
